Two-sample label-permutation null

Source: R/null_factories.R
null_two_sample.Rd

Builds an observed two-group t (or Z-equivalent) map and deterministic label-permutation null draws. Default contrast direction is level 2 minus level 1; pin a different direction with levels or contrast.

Usage

null_two_sample(
  images,
  group,
  mask = NULL,
  n_perm = 5000,
  seed = NULL,
  variance = c("welch", "pooled"),
  z_equiv = TRUE,
  template = NULL,
  levels = NULL,
  contrast = NULL
)

Arguments

images

Subject-level images (see as_subject_matrix()).

group

Vector of group labels (factor, character, or integer); coerced to a 2-level factor.

mask

Optional logical 3D mask.

n_perm

Number of label permutations.

seed

Optional random seed.

variance

"welch" (default) or "pooled".

z_equiv

If TRUE (default), convert t to Z-equivalent.

template

Optional template (only used for matrix input).

levels

Optional length-2 character giving the group level order used for the contrast (e.g., c("control", "case") → contrast is case - control). Overrides as.factor(group) ordering.

contrast

Optional length-2 character of the form c("positive", "negative") specifying that the contrast is mean(positive) - mean(negative). Equivalent to levels = rev(contrast).

Value

A null_spec.
